name: Osteoporosis
description: Systemic skeletal disorder of low bone mass and microarchitectural deterioration with increased fracture risk. Microgravity unloading recapitulates accelerated bone loss via sclerostin/Wnt suppression and RANKL-driven resorption, mirroring postmenopausal and disuse osteoporosis.

genes.mechanism: Encodes sclerostin, a Wnt inhibitor upregulated by unloading; loss-of-function causes high bone mass.
Wnt co-receptor; loss causes osteoporosis-pseudoglioma, gain causes high bone mass.
Master osteoblast transcription factor required for differentiation and mineralization.
Osteocalcin marks mature osteoblast activity and bone formation rate.
Major bone matrix collagen; mutations cause osteogenesis imperfecta with fragility.
Type I collagen alpha-2 chain; variants affect bone strength and fracture risk.
RANKL drives osteoclastogenesis; target of denosumab therapy.
Osteoprotegerin decoy receptor restraining RANKL; deletion causes juvenile Paget disease.
Cathepsin K degrades bone collagen; deficiency causes pycnodysostosis, inhibitors raise BMD.
TRAP marker of osteoclast number and resorptive activity.
Osteoinductive morphogen used in spinal fusion; drives RUNX2 expression.
Canonical Wnt ligand promoting osteoblastogenesis and bone accrual.
Estrogen receptor alpha; GWAS locus for BMD and postmenopausal bone loss.
Vitamin D receptor regulating calcium homeostasis and mineralization.
PTH receptor controlling remodeling; target of teriparatide anabolic therapy.

pubmed.title: Mechanical stimulation of bone in vivo reduces osteocyte expression of Sost/sclerostin

pubmed.citation: Vico et al. Effects of long-term microgravity exposure on cancellous and cortical weight-bearing bones of cosmonauts. Lancet 2000;355:1006-1010
Estrada et al. GWAS meta-analysis of bone mineral density. Nat Genet 2012

name: Sarcopenia (skeletal muscle atrophy)
description: Progressive loss of muscle mass, strength and function with ageing and disuse. Spaceflight unloading induces rapid atrophy through ubiquitin-proteasome activation (Atrogin-1/MuRF1), myostatin signaling and PGC-1alpha suppression, closely modeling sarcopenia.

genes.mechanism: Myostatin restrains muscle growth; null mutations cause hypermuscularity.
Atrogin-1 E3 ubiquitin ligase induced in every atrophy model; drives proteolysis.
MuRF1 E3 ligase degrading myosin heavy chain during atrophy.
Myogenic regulatory factor required for satellite-cell differentiation.
Myogenin drives terminal myoblast fusion and fiber maturation.
Slow beta-myosin heavy chain; fiber-type shifts mark disuse and myopathies.
Skeletal alpha-actin core thin-filament protein; mutations cause nemaline myopathy.
PGC-1alpha master regulator of mitochondrial biogenesis suppressed by unloading.
Transcription factor inducing Atrogin-1/MuRF1 under Akt inhibition.
Longevity-linked factor coordinating autophagy and proteasome atrophy programs.
Anabolic growth factor activating Akt/mTOR hypertrophy signaling.
Calpain-3 protease for sarcomere remodeling; mutations cause LGMD2A.
Myoglobin oxygen reservoir reflecting oxidative capacity and fiber type.

pubmed.title: Regulation of skeletal muscle mass in mice by a new TGF-beta superfamily member

pubmed.citation: Bodine et al. Identification of ubiquitin ligases required for skeletal muscle atrophy. Science 2001;294:1704-1708
Fitts et al. Prolonged space flight-induced alterations in human skeletal muscle fibres. J Physiol 2010;588:3567-3592

name: Immune senescence / inflammaging
description: Age-related remodeling of immunity with senescent-cell accumulation, SASP cytokine secretion (IL-6, IL-1B, CCL2) and p16/p21 checkpoint activation. Spaceflight reproduces blunted adaptive responses with elevated innate inflammation and latent-virus reactivation.

genes.mechanism: Canonical SASP cytokine and inflammaging biomarker predicting frailty and mortality.
Master pro-inflammatory cytokine driving NF-kB senescence reinforcement.
Inflammasome product central to SASP initiation and paracrine senescence.
Monocyte chemoattractant recruiting macrophages to senescent niches.
Interferon-induced chemokine elevated with ageing and viral reactivation.
Th1 cytokine commonly suppressed in flight, impairing antiviral defense.
p16INK4a senescence effector; expression rises exponentially with age.
p21CIP1 DNA-damage senescence checkpoint downstream of p53.
Guardian of genome gating senescence versus apoptosis after damage.
Master SASP transcription program sustaining chronic inflammation.
PAI-1 SASP factor and fibrosis mediator marking senescent burden.
Lysozyme innate-defense enzyme altered in flight immune dysregulation.

pubmed.title: Oncogenic ras provokes premature cell senescence associated with accumulation of p53 and p16

pubmed.citation: Franceschi et al. Inflamm-aging: an evolutionary perspective on immunosenescence. Ann N Y Acad Sci 2000
Crucian et al. Immune system dysregulation during spaceflight. Front Immunol 2018

name: Neurodegeneration (spaceflight-associated neurocognitive risk)
description: Bonus CNS panel linking flight stressors (radiation, fluid shifts, isolation) to neuroinflammation, reduced BDNF neurotrophism, astrogliosis and Alzheimer-like amyloid/tau signatures relevant to late-life dementia risk.

genes.mechanism: Neurotrophin supporting hippocampal plasticity; reduced by flight and in Alzheimer disease.
Astrocyte activation marker elevated in gliosis and neurodegeneration.
Strongest late-onset Alzheimer risk gene (E4 allele) modulating amyloid clearance.
Tau protein forming neurofibrillary tangles in tauopathies.
Neuroinflammatory cytokine linking peripheral SASP to cognitive decline.
Microglial cytokine driving synaptic loss in dementia models.
Senescent glia marker accumulating in aged and irradiated brain.
Antioxidant defense whose dysfunction causes oxidative neuronal injury.
Mitochondrial superoxide dismutase protecting neurons from radiation ROS.
Stress-inducible heme oxygenase marking oxidative stress in glia.

pubmed.citation: Britten et al. Space radiation and cognitive impairment. Radiat Res 2020
Cancedda et al. Hippocampal neurogenesis and spaceflight. Neuroscience 2019

name: Cardiovascular deconditioning
description: Microgravity cardiac unloading with reduced stroke volume, myosin isoform switching, endothelial dysfunction and arterial stiffness. Flight mirrors bed-rest cardiac atrophy and early heart-failure remodeling with natriuretic-peptide activation.

genes.mechanism: Alpha-myosin fast isoform downregulated in unloaded and failing hearts.
Beta-myosin upregulated in hypertrophic remodeling and flight hearts.
Atrial natriuretic peptide released under wall stress and volume shifts.
Cytoskeletal actin reflecting sarcomeric remodeling in deconditioning.
Angiogenic factor suppressed in flight, impairing microvascular maintenance.
Hypoxia-inducible factor coordinating vascular adaptation to unloading.
Endothelial nitric oxide synthase governing vasodilation; reduced in stiffness.
Profibrotic cytokine driving cardiac fibrosis after remodeling.
Matrix metalloproteinase remodeling extracellular matrix in atrophy.
Endogenous MMP inhibitor balancing fibrotic remodeling.
Monocyte chemoattractant linking vascular inflammation to stiffness.
Vascular inflammation mediator elevated in deconditioning.

pubmed.title: The NASA Twins Study: A multidimensional analysis of a year-long human spaceflight

pubmed.citation: Perhonen et al. Cardiac atrophy after bed rest and spaceflight. J Appl Physiol 2001

name: Space radiation carcinogenesis
description: High-LET galactic cosmic rays and solar particles cause clustered DNA lesions, p53 checkpoint activation and senescence or misrepair that elevates long-term cancer risk. Flight signatures center on ATM/BRCA/RAD51 repair capacity and GADD45A/CDKN1A arrest.

genes.mechanism: Apical DNA-damage kinase mutated in ataxia-telangiectasia with radiosensitivity.
Homologous-recombination repair gene; loss confers breast/ovarian cancer risk.
Checkpoint kinase relaying ATM to p53/CDC25 arrest and apoptosis.
Stress-inducible growth-arrest transcript, a biodosimetry marker of irradiation.
p21 arrest effector induced by virtually all radiation exposures.
gamma-H2AX foci mark DNA double-strand break number and repair kinetics.
Recombinase executing homologous-recombination repair of breaks.
E3 ligase restraining p53; amplification drives sarcomas.
Most-mutated tumor suppressor gating irradiated-cell fate.
Survival signaling modulating post-irradiation inflammation and fate.
NRF2 oxidative-stress regulator mitigating radiation ROS damage.
p53-target SASP/fibrosis gene elevated after therapeutic irradiation.

pubmed.citation: Beheshti et al. Space radiation and DNA damage response. Front Physiol 2021
Cucinotta et al. Space radiation cancer risk projections. Radiat Environ Biophys 2017
